profile_text.body:
SentinelOne is a publicly traded cybersecurity company (NYSE: S, CIK 0001583708) that describes itself as offering an AI-powered enterprise cybersecurity platform. The company's site presents its core offering as a unified platform covering endpoint, cloud, identity, and data protection, supported by what it calls a Security Data Lake. It positions the platform as AI-native, designed to detect, contain, and respond to threats at machine speed, and claims recognition in the inaugural IDC MarketScape for SIEM.

The company's principal AI product is SentinelOne Purple AI, tracked here under the Security and Identity AI category. It is described as combining endpoint security, autonomous response, and extended detection and response capabilities, including kill-switch functionality, within a single lightweight agent. The site states that Purple AI and agentic workflows handle triage, correlation, and routine response tasks, with the stated aim of freeing analysts for higher-value decisions. SentinelOne also describes its platform as capable of protecting the AI systems its customers operate, in addition to conventional enterprise infrastructure.

No litigation, MCP server registrations, or patent filings are recorded in the held facts for this company at this time.
